text: These are the Poles! The top and the bottom of the world.
The North Pole is a frozen ocean. The South Pole is a frozen land.
Polar bears live in the north, and penguins live in the south. They never meet!
When it's summer at the North Pole, it's winter at the South Pole.
At the poles, the sun stays up for months, then stays down for months.
Polar bears have black skin under their white fur.
Arctic foxes turn white in winter and brown in summer.
Penguins slide on their tummies to go fast.
Emperor penguin dads keep the egg warm on their feet.
Narwhals have a long tooth that grows out like a unicorn horn!
